submission_contract.explicit_defaults: All fixed values are expanded into the stored normalized ResearchRunSpec before identity calculation; transaction_cost_bps has no default.

editable_fields.validation_rule: Finite and exactly 0 or 5. NaN, infinity, negative values, and other finite values are rejected.
editable_fields.financial_meaning: One-way fee in basis points charged on actual absolute traded notional.
editable_fields.backend_mapping: The adapter executes the unchanged committed dual-scenario [0,5] campaign in a fresh attempt root and selects the requested scenario from actual engine outputs.
editable_fields.identity_effect: Included in canonical ResearchRunSpec identity; changing 0 to 5 changes run_id.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Researches a time-varying SPY risky sleeve using the certified capital exposure campaign.
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Other research modes are outside the Phase B1 execution allowlist.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Uses the committed adjusted-close historical observations rather than a synthetic fixture or frozen-result replay.
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Synthetic and frozen-replay execution scopes are not accepted by the Phase B1 service.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: SPY is the sole operated risky asset whose exposure and cash sleeve determine the research index.
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: No additional operated universe is certified for Phase B1.

fixed_fields.validation_rule: Must match the committed ordered 22-symbol reference universe.
fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Historical observations supplied to the current-regime model as its information set.
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Candidate definitions and input ordering remain fixed to the committed campaign.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Selects on each training window and evaluates the selected candidate on the following outer OOS window.
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Nested walk-forward is outside Phase B1.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Inclusive beginning of the committed research campaign and its first training window.
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Phase B1 may not alter the committed validation windows.

fixed_fields.validation_rule: Must equal the exclusive ISO date 2024-01-01.
fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Exclusive end of the committed campaign and final outer OOS window.
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Phase B1 may not alter the committed validation windows.

value.signal_rule: market rows supplied to predict have date before signalDate
value.fit_rule: training rows are bounded by [training_start, training_end_exclusive)

fixed_fields.validation_rule: Must preserve the certified strict training/signal/execution cutoff rules and unverified data-vintage status.
fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Defines which observations may inform each historical decision and when the resulting exposure is executed.
fixed_fields.backend_mapping: Capital engine fold construction, model fit/predict contract and calculator next-close execution
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Phase B1 does not expose alternate cutoff or execution timing rules.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: No benchmark-relative return or attribution is produced by this engine path.
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: The selected engine does not produce a benchmark-relative result.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Identifies the committed candidate grid and training-score selector that chooses each fold's exposure policy.
fixed_fields.backend_mapping: Committed campaign candidate_space, search and selection_metric
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Candidate definitions and selection semantics are certified fixed inputs.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Identifies the certified capital research engine semantics used by the grid selector.
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Engine-version selection is not a Phase B1 user control.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Ranks valid training-window candidates by their net Sharpe score at the fixed selection cost.
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Phase B1 does not expose an allocator objective or selection-metric control.

fixed_fields.validation_rule: Must match the committed candidate-space hash, model, lookback, policies and execution bounds.
fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Defines the deterministic regime-model candidates and exposure policies evaluated inside each training fold.
fixed_fields.backend_mapping: Campaign.search, candidate_space, candidate_budget, warmup_rows and max_jobs
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Model, lookback, candidate, warmup and job-budget changes are outside Phase B1.

fixed_fields.validation_rule: Must match the committed turnover, drawdown, exposure, shorting and leverage constraints.
fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Sets the validity gates and long-only unlevered exposure bounds used by the campaign.
fixed_fields.backend_mapping: Campaign.constraints, shorting policy and leverage policy
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Constraint editing is outside Phase B1.

fixed_fields.validation_rule: Must match the committed 24/12/12 rolling traditional walk-forward clock.
fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Defines the training and outer OOS calendar used to select and evaluate candidates without future rows.
fixed_fields.backend_mapping: Campaign train_months, test_months, step_months, recalibration_frequency and window_type
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Date-window and walk-forward-clock editing is outside Phase B1.

fixed_fields.validation_rule: Must match the committed selector cost, dual output scenarios, zero yields/slippage and initial fold NAV.
fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Defines fixed campaign economics surrounding the one editable output-scenario transaction cost.
fixed_fields.backend_mapping: Campaign selection_cost_bps, transaction_cost_bps, slippage/yields and initial_nav
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Only the returned transaction-cost scenario is editable in Phase B1.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: This exposure-policy campaign does not consume an asset expected-return vector.
fixed_fields.backend_mapping: No expected-return input in the selected capital engine path
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Expected-return model selection is unavailable for this research mode.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: This single-risk-asset exposure-policy campaign does not optimize from an asset covariance matrix.
fixed_fields.backend_mapping: No covariance-method input in the selected capital engine path
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Covariance-method selection is unavailable for this research mode.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: No separate allocator risk-mandate object is consumed; fixed campaign exposure constraints apply.
fixed_fields.backend_mapping: No risk-mandate input in the selected capital engine path
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Risk-mandate editing is unavailable for this research mode.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: The exposure policy may rebalance on the committed monthly schedule.
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Phase B1 does not expose cadence changes.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Training-score candidate selection is evaluated using a fixed five-basis-point cost assumption.
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: Selection economics remain fixed while the requested output scenario changes.

fixed_fields.validation_rule: Must equal the committed positive integer 200.
fixed_fields.financial_meaning: Bounds the committed grid candidate enumeration; it is not a financial preference control.
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: No arbitrary candidate-budget control is exposed in Phase B1.

fixed_fields.financial_meaning: The committed exhaustive grid path has no stochastic selection step requiring a seed.
fixed_fields.backend_mapping: Deterministic campaign enumeration and capital engine
fixed_fields.unsupported_reason: The selected engine path has no random-seed input.
